title: Progress map (child home) + collection scene screens (Unit 9)
accept: Map reflects StoryProgress exactly for fixture profiles: level path drawn as an illustrated trail; completed stories shown by thumbnail; the rolling window's 3 available stories 'awake' and gently animated (state from phonics-engine storiesFor); future stories visible but visually asleep (widget tests over locked/available/completed fixtures — transcribed acceptance).
Tapping any completed story allows re-reading (navigation callback fires with the story); tapping an asleep story does nothing (tests).

Tongue-twister booster nodes interleave the trail with a distinct visual treatment, tagged to a level and unlocked with it, always replayable ([DEVICE] golden for the distinct treatment; headless proxy: widget test asserts booster nodes present at their level positions with the booster node type/style token).

Collection scene: one persistent illustrated scene where every earned collectible renders at its authored sceneSlot; collectibles individually tappable, triggering the Rive collect/poke reaction on that collectible's stage (FakeStoryStage assertion); unearned collectibles absent (tests).
Completing a story adds exactly one collectible at its authored slot; re-reading adds none (test over CollectionState fixtures — transcribed acceptance).

Both screens are strictly per-profile with no global/comparative elements; profile switch swaps map + collection state completely (integration test with two fixture profiles — transcribed acceptance).

Scene capacity covers all launch collectibles and the extension direction for future packs (scrollable/expanding per the style guide) is honored in the layout primitive (test: scene renders a beyond-launch collectible count without overflow by extending).
All four layout classes render without overflow (headless layout tests; [DEVICE] goldens for both screens routed to owner).

Map renders the highlighted-story treatment for a story id passed in the return-navigation payload from the celebration sequence (widget test) — Unit 8 'returns to the map with the next story highlighted'.
pinned_design: Unit 9 pinned: progress map = child home screen; illustrated trail of the level path; completed → thumbnail; the 3 rolling-window stories awake/gently animated; future stories asleep but visible; completed stories re-readable by tap; booster nodes (Unit 14) interleaved with distinct visual treatment (target ≈ 1 per 3 stories, tagged to a level, unlocked with it, always replayable). Collection = one persistent illustrated scene (e.g. a garden); collectibles live at authored sceneSlots, individually tappable for a small reaction (Rive collect/poke); the scene fills with progress — the child's owned space. Both per-profile; no leaderboards or cross-profile visibility. Scene extension direction (scrollable/expanding) is pinned with the illustrator in the Unit 1 style guide — build the layout to extend.
notes: Story availability logic comes from phonics-engine (do not reimplement the rolling window here). Real trail/scene illustrations are owner-commissioned (OQ-4) — use token-styled placeholder painting behind refs. Twister node DATA comes from domain-models TongueTwister + TwisterProgress; the twister flow screen is twister-flow's ticket (navigation callback only). 'Next story highlighted' on return from celebration arrives via navigation payload.
